summary: Iteration 9 validated the new async strategy-discovery engine (5-year D1 train/last-year-test walk-forward) end-to-end. Backend pytest: 8/8 passed in /app/backend/tests/test_discover.py (137s wall). Frontend playwright: full demo login → discover-panel → discover-run-button → 'Apprendimento in corso…' label → polling → discover-result with PROFITTEVOLE (ultimo anno) verdict badge, discover-seg-0 (2021-07-26 → 2025-09-18, WR40.9% PF1.36 Ann3.4% Net €1412 66trades) and discover-seg-1 (2025-09-21 → 2026-09-21, WR42.9% PF1.46 Ann3.7% Net €374.8 14trades) → discover-apply-button → forward-test-panel replay. Zero console errors. Verdict consistency rule (profittevole ⇒ last_year.net>0 & PF≥1.1) held on EUR/USD, XAU/USD, US30. D1 cache proven: first EUR/USD call 4.6s, second 3.3s (cached path). Source='real' (MetaApi), period spans ~5y (2021-07 → 2026-09). Paginated D1 fetch returned enough candles (train equity_curve ≥500 pts, val 150-400 pts). 404 responses correct on unknown job_id and unknown symbol. New 'trend' entry + 'rsi' filter run through /api/forwardtest/run with mode='optimized' and produces trades+metrics. combos_tested=192 (matches DISCOVER_GRID).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1178 lines (recurring). Discover job store `_discover_jobs` and D1 cache `_d1_cache` are pure in-memory dicts with no size cap / no TTL eviction for jobs — a long-running instance will leak memory. Add a max size + LRU eviction, or drop finished jobs after ~30 min.

server.py:987 cache TTL condition `len(hit[1]) >= want * 0.9` means a discover with years=5 (want≈1340) will re-fetch if the cached array is <1206 candles — but paginated fetch may return exactly 1300ish. Fine today, but if MetaApi returns fewer candles on some pages the cache would silently churn. Consider caching by (symbol, want_bucket) or always keep the largest fetched window.
server.py CORS: `allow_credentials=False` with `allow_origins=['*']` is fine for a demo but incompatible with future httpOnly-cookie auth flows — noted for later.

server.py: _run_discover uses `asyncio.create_task` without keeping a reference — Python GC can cancel it. Store the task on the job dict to prevent 'Task was destroyed while pending' warnings under load.
DISCOVER_GRID hard-coded to 192 combos; consider externalizing so future users can trade compute-vs-search-space without editing code.
